sloka: गृह्याञ्जलौ समाकृष्य सस्वजे प्रियमात्मजम् ।तस्मै चाभ्युदितं दिव्यं मणिकाञ्चनभूषितं ॥२-३-३४॥
transliteration: gṛhyāñjalau samākṛṣya sasvaje priyamātmajam ।tasmai cābhyuditaṁ divyaṁ maṇikāñcanabhūṣitaṁ ॥2-3-34॥

translations.english: The king (Dasaratha) offered Rama a seat on the lofty, glorious throne splendidly decorated with gold and gems.
